summary: Interim bail for election canvassing rejected; no legal right to campaign while in custody; precedent from Arvind Kejriwal cited; risk of witness tampering in locality-specific riot cases; Section 62(5) R.P. Act, 1951 bars voting by prisoners; interim bail not justified for elections; Pandora’s box and floodgates concerns; regular bail pending; custody parole for nomination filing permitted, but not physical canvassing.
final_judgment: Interim bail application dismissed; appeal rejected; no interim release granted for election campaigning.
